name: Nina Schwalbe
title: Founder and President
bio: Nina founded Spark Street in 2016. Her leadership positions include Managing Director for Policy and Performance at Gavi, the vaccine alliance, where she led Gavi's work in strategic planning, policy development, market-shaping, performance management, and monitoring and evaluation; Principal Advisor and Acting Chief of Health at Unicef, overseeing their health programs in over 150 countries; and Director of Global Public Health for the Open Society Institute. During the COVID-19 pandemic, she established USAID's COVID-19 Vaccine Access and Delivery Initiative and served as its first director. Nina holds a BA from Harvard, an MPH from Columbia and PhD from Witwatersrand University. A lifetime member of the Council on Foreign Relations, a Senior Scholar at Georgetown University's O'Neill Institute for National and Global Health Law, a Principal Visiting Fellow at the United Nations International Institute for Global Health, and a Lancet Commissioner for gender and health.

name: Abdallah Bchir
title: Senior Advisor
bio: Abdallah is a public health specialist with extensive experience in evaluation. He started his career as a medical doctor and professor of Public Health in Tunisia. He served as the Head of Gavi's Evaluation Unit, where he introduced the concepts of theory of change and prospective evaluation to Gavi's work. He has also worked as a consultant for WHO and served on the Global Fund's Technical Evaluation Reference Group. Abdallah holds MSc and PhD degrees in community health from the University of Montreal and currently splits his time between Geneva and Tunis. He is fluent in English, Arabic, and French.

name: Clara Greiner
title: Senior Program Manager
bio: Clara is a health specialist with expertise in global public health, development, gender and rights. Prior to Spark Street, she oversaw Fondation Botnar's grants portfolio on advancing digital rights and young people's wellbeing. During COVID-19, Clara coordinated public health and vaccination monitoring between political, academic, and public stakeholders at the Swiss Ministry of Health. She has also worked for UNFPA Myanmar, assessing humanitarian response and gender and rights policy. Clara holds a MPH from Imperial College London and a BSc in Molecular Biology from the University of Basel. She is fluent in German and English and proficient in French.

name: Prakash Durairaj
title: Visual Lead
bio: Prakash leads Spark Street's graphic design work. He started his career in finance before becoming a designer. He has worked for a Fortune 500 company as a Visualizer and enjoys exploring how to use innovative tools to visualize creative concepts. He has over 14 years of experience in the fields of design and user experience and holds a Bachelor's of Computer Application. He is fluent in English and Tamil.

name: Susanna Lehtimaki
title: Acting CEO and Research Director
bio: Susanna is a global health specialist, focusing on results-based program development, strategic planning, and analysis. She has worked with UNICEF at headquarters in New York as well as in Kyrgyzstan and Ukraine where she developed programs on maternal, child and adolescent health and wellbeing. She has a clinical background in maternal, child and school health in Finland and in India. Susanna holds an MA in Public Health and a BA in Social Sciences from Tampere University, Finland, and an MA in Russian and Eurasian Studies from European University in St. Petersburg, Russia. In addition to Finnish, Susanna is fluent in English and Russian.

name: Elizabeth Gardiner
title: Senior Researcher
bio: Elizabeth is a global health specialist with expertise in product access and scale-up of coverage. She has worked with over 50 countries and formed multidisciplinary partnerships with pharmaceutical and NGO partners on issues ranging from HIV prevention to tuberculosis to reproductive health. Leading strategy and operations, Elizabeth has experience with product distribution in public and private markets. Elizabeth has degrees from Harvard University and the London Business School. She is fluent in English and highly proficient in Russian.

name: Brian Wahl
title: Senior Advisor
bio: Brian is an infectious disease epidemiologist specializing in pneumonia in children and immunization. He holds a faculty position in the Yale School of Public Health and also serves as co-lead of the Yale India Health Network, a multidisciplinary partnership advancing research, education, and policy to improve health outcomes in India. In addition to his research, he also has a background in public health policy and advocacy. Brian has studied the application of advanced analytic tools, including artificial intelligence, for the prevention, control, and treatment of diseases that disproportionately affect low- and middle-income countries. He earned his PhD and MPH from the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health and was based in South Asia for more than a decade. He speaks English, German, and Hindi.

name: Dante Licona
title: Social Media Strategist
bio: Dante is a social media strategist and international consultant with expertise in strategic communication. He has served in different roles with the Mexican government, WHO, and the Red Cross Red Crescent movement. In these roles, he has led record-breaking global campaigns on TikTok, forged partnerships with tech companies, responded to emergencies around the world, trained hundreds of colleagues on the effective use of social media, and designed strategies for maximizing impact through digital channels. Dante is fluent in English, French, and Spanish.
